channel.title: Spotted. Dope Daily Ad Campaigns
channel.description: A dope new ad campaign revealed every weekday at midday. Who made it and why it's good.

item.title: Barclays by VCCP: “We've Got Your Back”
item.description:
Barclays by VCCP

Campaign: “We've Got Your Back”

Mimes stalking people and copying their every move. That's fraud. Creepier than any scary stat, and the song is 'Somebody's Watching Me'. Obviously.

Read more on Creative Salon

item.title: Throwback Thursday: Heineken by Publicis Dublin & LePub Milan: “The Pub That Refused To Die”
item.description:
Heineken by Publicis Dublin & LePub Milan

Campaign: “The Pub That Refused To Die”

Grand Prix, Creative Strategy · Cannes Lions 2026

26 villagers with zero pub experience bought their last pub to save it. Heineken made it a documentary. Beer ad, zero beer chat.

Read more on LBB

item.title: Sainsbury's by New Commercial Arts: “The Big Delivery”
item.description:
Sainsbury's by New Commercial Arts

Campaign: “The Big Delivery”

The BFG has a cold, so two staff drive dinner into Giant Country. Year three of the giant. Still not bored.

Read more on Ads of the World

item.title: Throwback Tuesday: KitKat by VML UK & Burson: “The KitKat Heist”
item.description:
KitKat by VML UK & Burson

Campaign: “The KitKat Heist”

Grand Prix, PR · Cannes Lions 2026

Someone nicked 12 tonnes of KitKats. They let everyone track it. We get it. Fair.

Read more on LBB

item.title: Tesco by BBH London: “The Wrong Address”
item.description:
Tesco by BBH London

Campaign: “The Wrong Address”

Christmas shop sent to her old house. A delivery driver sorts it. Very British panic, very nice ending.

Read more on Creative Salon

item.title: Coca-Cola by Ogilvy (WPP Open X): “Enjoy Joy”
item.description:
Coca-Cola by Ogilvy (WPP Open X)

Campaign: “Enjoy Joy”

After two years of AI-made Christmas ads, Coke's back to filming actual people. Turkey frying, football, family. Humans: back in fashion.

Read more on Marketing Dive

item.title: The Entertainer by PrettyGreen: “Play. Their Way”
item.description:
The Entertainer by PrettyGreen

Campaign: “Play. Their Way”

Kids turn the living room into a racetrack and fire RC cars at the sprouts. Dad caves. No tears, no piano. Just noise.

Read more on Toy World

item.title: Apple by TBWA\Media Arts Lab: “The Dreamer”
item.description:
Apple by TBWA\Media Arts Lab

Campaign: “The Dreamer”

Boy hides his drawings for years, then his parents get him a MacBook. Nearly four minutes, no dialogue, art by Hebru Brantley. Yeah, it got us.

Read more on B&T

item.title: Netflix by Mother (with Netflix's Brand Creative Studio): “Find the Thing You Never Knew You Needed”
item.description:
Netflix by Mother (with Netflix's Brand Creative Studio)

Campaign: “Find the Thing You Never Knew You Needed”

A vampire risks daylight because his telly broke halfway through Love Is Blind. Relatable. Three mini-films about getting hooked on stuff you'd never pick.

Read more on The Drum

item.title: Waitrose by Wonderhood Studios: “The Perfect Gift 2”
item.description:
Waitrose by Wonderhood Studios

Campaign: “The Perfect Gift 2”

Keira Knightley rom-com sequel where a beef Wellington crashes a wedding. Six minutes long. A supermarket made a film and nobody stopped them.

Read more on B&T

item.title: Xfinity by Goodby Silverstein & Partners: “The Ghost of Christmas Very-Recent-Past”
item.description:
Xfinity by Goodby Silverstein & Partners

Campaign: “The Ghost of Christmas Very-Recent-Past”

John C. Reilly haunts people glued to their phones and shows them what they just missed. A broadband brand telling you to log off. Bit cheeky.

Read more on Adweek

item.title: Disney by adam&eve\TBWA: “The Invisible Horse”
item.description:
Disney by adam&eve\TBWA

Campaign: “The Invisible Horse”

A kid makes friends with a horse you never actually see. Hoofprints, wobbly furniture, done. Showing nothing and making you feel everything. Show-offs.

Read more on B&T

item.title: Oxfam by Happy Hour: “The List”
item.description:
Oxfam by Happy Hour

Campaign: “The List”

A kid's Christmas list floats off on a balloon and the neighbours sort every gift, second-hand. Twist: the list was never for him. Tissues.

Read more on Retail Times

item.title: M&S by Mother: “The Home of Christmas”
item.description:
M&S by Mother

Campaign: “The Home of Christmas”

Santa shaves off his beard to go Christmas shopping undercover. Santa is James Norton. The internet noticed.

Read more on Famous Campaigns

item.title: JD by Uncommon Creative Studio: “Create The New”
item.description:
JD by Uncommon Creative Studio

Campaign: “Create The New”

25-odd athletes, musicians and designers making new stuff together. Barely mentions Christmas. Bold.

Read more on DesignRush

item.title: Arsenal by Arsenal Creative Studio (in-house): “'Twas the Season”
item.description:
Arsenal by Arsenal Creative Studio (in-house)

Campaign: “'Twas the Season”

Colin Firth narrates what sounds like Christmas morning. It's actually about winning the league. Fever Pitch fans, this one's for you.

Read more on ContentGrip

item.title: LEGO by Our LEGO Agency (in-house): “The LEGO Holiday Workshop”
item.description:
LEGO by Our LEGO Agency (in-house)

Campaign: “The LEGO Holiday Workshop”

One brick travels through Daft Punk, Marvel and K-pop. Gifts so good you won't want to hand them over. Relatable.

Read more on ContentGrip

item.title: John Lewis by Saatchi & Saatchi: “Gloria and Pickles”
item.description:
John Lewis by Saatchi & Saatchi

Campaign: “Gloria and Pickles”

Gran stops handing out cash and builds the grandkids a Gran Cave instead. A Christmas ad telling you to buy an actual present. Sneaky. Works.

Read more on The Drum

item.title: Argos by T&P: “Tales of Argos Past”
item.description:
Argos by T&P

Campaign: “Tales of Argos Past”

Richard Ayoade plays Scrooge. Connie and Trevor are the ghosts. Argos taking the mick out of its own 'just toys' reputation. Nice.

Read more on Retail Gazette
